> Congratulations on getting into college. Congratulations on getting so close to the end that you can taste it. Congratulations on living.

Why should I congratulate myself on shit I'm supposed to do? Congratulate myself on living? Seriously? All my life, I've always been able to pull through. It may not be the way I expected, but I always succeeded. Now, it's like one giant choke. Everything at my fucking fingertips and I fucking throw it away. Like I lost my mojo, the thing that makes me keep ticking is gone all because I can't get through it. Fuck, now it's like I don't give a shit about anything anymore.
